rows.text: # Task commitments: content and prospective topology review

2026-09-09. Agent adversarial review of task-commitment/0.1-draft.
**Components accepted in direction only; whole shape and allocation remain open.**
No existing CONTENT/VAL/REG/ADAPT contract is relabelled or reopened.
## 1. Concrete authored instances without another identity family

Use one170/1 governed content record per concrete task instance. StableId is the
existing GovernedContentDefinitionId/1038; SemanticKind is the proposed exact
SemanticKindId/1004 member semantic-kind/task-commitment. TaskReferent is exactly
SemanticReferentId/1002(AuthoredContentOriginId/1037(complete StableId)).

Recurrences have different StableIds. Neither stakeholder nor task prototype is
the instance identity. This first profile has a finite authored instance domain;
runtime-created adoption/recurrence remains unadmitted. No runtime origin is forged
in S0, and no new TaskInstanceId namespace or identity registry is needed.

Character qualification is unchanged: an authored task referent fails the existing
character-kind predicate. A new separately declared task-kind predicate can qualify
a TaskReferent by exact authored origin and committed content kind. It must not be
made an alternative successful branch of validator/character-qualification.
## 2. One spec authority; no executable prose or psychological content
Propose a TaskCommitmentSpec registry entry containing exactly:

| Field | Grammar and authority |
|---|---|
| HolderContentId | GovernedContentDefinitionId; resolves to character-kind content |
| PredictionDefinitionId | Existing RegistryDefinitionId; resolves to the admitted prediction criterion/channel domain |
| DesiredMinimum | Exact rational inside that prediction domain |
| DesiredMaximum | Exact rational, DesiredMinimum≤DesiredMaximum |
| ActiveFrom | Exact simulation instant≥0 |
| Deadline | Exact simulation instant>ActiveFrom |

A concrete task content record maps to exactly one spec through a closed receiving
profile. The final content-kind grammar must choose the precise170 field positions
for that reference; references, lifecycle declaration and semantic mapping must all
resolve to the same committed spec, not duplicate the criterion/window themselves.
The spec can serve only its declared concrete content instance in this version;
two recurrences may have equal criterion but independently declared windows/specs.

The spec contains no interpretation, urgency, concern, pressure, reward, success
probability, action efficacy or identity conclusion. A separate motive/calibration
registry may define the reference mechanism's common coefficients, but content
cannot inject a raw psychological result. Authored lifecycle and goal facts are
permitted by CONTENT_GOVERNANCE; authored psychological conclusions are not.

Reuse329/1 for the content-kind declaration and330/1 for the exact task-role
predicate if their existing field grammar is sufficient. Their **new exact
specialization versions and member identities** must commit the additional meaning.
Do not pretend content-kind/0.1's character-only supported domain already admits it.

The real compiler currently assumes every content record is a Character. In
particular REG's implementation enumerates all current content records, because
that is true of every previously admitted model. A successor compiler must supply
the actual qualified-character image, or explicitly update that implementation to
filter by the accepted Character predicate. It must not demand REG anchors for
task records or weaken Character qualification. Existing one-kind source bytes and
their earlier rejection controls remain unchanged.
## 3. Prospective control is not a synthetic appetite or mislabeled learning

The ten-family ADAPT registry is explicitly exhaustive **for its initial model**.
Its route membership is independent from mutation ownership and admission. The
architecture separately requires prospective goals/commitments; they are not one
of those ten learned/adaptation families. Hiding their state in belief, memory or
identity would merge separate authorities without a reduction verdict.

Propose a successor topology with the ten unchanged rows plus one
prospective-commitments family. Assign a separately declared logical route,
route/prospective-control, using the existing logical route identity family. The
new member's semantics require an explicit extension; its namespace's historical
LearningRouteId label does not confer admission or make clock control into learning.

The new prospective family has one physical root and one sole authority. Its
explicit route does not authorize an automatic-adaptation transition to write it.
Conversely a prospective control transition cannot write any of the ten other
families merely because it consumed character-relative evidence. Record the full
eleven-family route/root/owner coverage before implementation.

342 may be explicitly admitted as an observer-safe prospective satisfaction input
without becoming AutomaticAdaptationInput or a universal lifecycle credential.
Its M1 producer remains on character-learning. This is a new, named downstream
consumer of the same evidence, not an implicit cross-route cast. Deadline control
has its own authenticated clock/initial-instance source and never manufactures a
measurement-learning record to disguise its origin.

A prospective trace or terminal output must be included in its own output closure.
The old character-learning and automatic-adaptation closures retain their previous
members. Future phenomenon comparisons must additionally preserve/probe prospective
state explicitly; a third route is not a loophole to omit it from causal tests.
## 4. Initial context and lifecycle scope

The first successor may initialize exactly its declared finite task keys as Open.
That is explicit initial adopted context under S0, not a claim that the runtime
performed adoption. No caller-authored appraisal, pressure, Reason or intent is an
input intermediate. All of those must be generated by their subsequent transitions.

The exact immutable window gives dormant/active/deadline eligibility. Open is not
synonymous with currently active. Physical DeadlineMissed commits at the deadline's
140 stage; earlier40/60 eligibility already excludes T≥Deadline.

PerceivedSatisfied and DeadlineMissed are distinct retained terminal states. This
version does not claim Relinquished, Cancelled or socially Fulfilled by naming them
in an enum. Those future causes require their own evidence and control transitions.
The historical live-list test is compared on live pressure and recurrence identity,
not on unimplemented social attribution.
## Adversarial disposition and remaining blockers

Still unresolved: exact170 field grammar, registration schemas and roles; initial
deadline association allocation/persistence; same-target clock/measurement resolution;
complete140 successor dispatcher; terminal output schema; workspace selection and
appraisal/affect/motive mathematics. These can change authoritative results. No
component/whole SHAPE ACCEPT, numeric allocation or implementation follows yet.

Next autonomous pass must close the content/lifecycle registration inventory and
deadline collision rule, then review the separate workspace/appraisal/motive seams.
The retained reasons/dice/identity/intent/attempt path remains required afterward.
# Task lifecycle successor packaging — revision1

2026-09-09. Construction proposal after symbolic and numeric task acceptance.
No model is frozen or activated by this document.
## First executable boundary

Build a lifecycle-only successor of the qualified prediction model. It adds adopted
task state, two-kind content validation, M1 settlement and initial deadline scheduling.
It does not yet activate the workspace/appraisal drafts or admit DeliberationOpportunity.
That keeps all executable edges contracted without supplying a dummy motive handler.
Later full cognition gets its own successor profile and exact additional source kinds.

| Identity field | Proposed value |
|---|---|
| Rules | rules/campaign2-task-commitment/0.1-candidate |
| Registry | campaign2-task-commitment-registry/0.1-candidate |
| Numeric | numeric/task-commitment-exact/0.1-candidate |
| Trace | campaign2-task-commitment-trace-binding/0.1-candidate |
| Persistence | campaign2-task-commitment-persistence/0.1-candidate |

Preserve content/0.2-candidate and the prior parameter schema/bytes, including
MaxSettlementWorkPerSimulationInstant100. Preserve the exact old original-input
entry profile: probe remains sole original source at its instant; authored facts
keep their previous grammar. Deadlines are private compiled initial events, not
extra original input entries. RNG remains unused and PERSIST-I remains deferred.
## Exact construction specimen family

Retain the six prediction controls (available, permitted, formation, memory read,
prediction application, prediction read) as committed registrations. Task adoption
is independent S0 data, not a model Boolean. The first source family has two concrete
task content records with fixed model-local1038 IDs content/task-a and content/task-b,
and unique1027 specs definition/task-a and definition/task-b. Both use the prior
qualified holder and definition/measurement-prediction.
For finite qualification, materialize these three declaration specimens:

| Specimen | A interval/window | B interval/window |
|---|---|---|
| overlapping | [4,6], [1,5) | [5,7], [1,6) |
| coincident deadline | [4,6], [1,5) | [5,7], [1,5) |
| recurrence | [4,6], [1,4) | [4,6], [4,7) |

The specimen label is a construction convenience, not an authoritative hidden input.
Its exact spec values are in the registry/content commitment and distinguish model
digests. An exact-source compiler derives the finite specimen/control combination
from complete declarations and compares the full expected source. No caller evaluator,
projection, task-kind callback or dynamic model mutation is accepted.

S0 admits any subset of the two exact task keys as Open. All other initial rules
remain unchanged. Every run schedules both deadlines regardless of that subset.
Same-model adoption interventions therefore preserve initial scheduler allocations.
## Six-slot registry closure

0: preserve prior descriptors/declarations and add370..376/1. Add task329/330 entries,
two task specs370 and the two375/376 registrations. Add the third route and two
transition memberships to279; add no occurrence entry for any task record. Extend
284 with one373 physical root/leaf mapping for prospective-commitments. The changed
route/family specialization receives explicitly named prospective extension versions
in the semantic bundle; do not pretend the initial two-route/ten-family domain changed.

1: identical phase registry.2: prospective authority153 leaf373/1/MapKey(*), grammar372,
RemovalAllowed=false.3: preserve read-only declarations; adopted task state is owned,
not a second read-only IDN family.4: key grammar371 for373/1.5: ten new scalar role
positions and two map-key positions from the frozen allocation, plus all old roles.
The TaskSpecIds set is checked by its receiving compiler, never scalar265.

Task content170 uses exact spec delegation including field13. Task kind329/1 points
to170/1; task predicate330/1 points to semantic-kind/task-commitment. Existing
character entries retain their exact semantics. Complete content closure precedes
construction of the role-bearing state/projection capabilities.
## Scheduling and stage accounting

Shared EventId/Sequence first allocates the original input schedule, then exactly
two deadline events in task-key order. Both are private/persisted pending associations
even if neither task is adopted. Runtime output ordinal state is unchanged by them.

On each M1 completion append one S child after the prior generated children; this
changes the probe-instant generated-child total from13 to14. Its runtime output
ordinal total remains7. The task slot emits no child/output whether it changes0/1/2
statuses or is padding. Existing later memory/prediction diagnostic read slots retain
their two runtime ordinals and original semantics.

At140 partition the scheduled list into A/P/S/D under the exact accepted grammar,
authenticate and resolve every target before priors, and compose only the validated
group patches against common B0. Source order is scheduler order, not map enumeration.
Do not pass deadline events to the old exclusive prediction-pair validator as members
of its pair; validate its exact two-member subgroup and the complete successor plan.

Maximum additional executed task work is one S plus two D events at an instant.
The final materialization review must compute the complete inherited event budget,
including delayed reads, before confirming the unchanged100 ceiling. This prose
does not itself pass the ceiling/control vector.
## Trace and persistence

Use full successor ModelIdentity and RunIdentity in every inherited and new trace.
The task-source record is342 for S and absent for clock D; key payload is not a
fabricated occurrence. Actual status absence is an actual read, not an omitted trace.
Group patches/diffs stay owned and separate even when one atomic state commit applies
them. S-padding has no source, IDN read, status read, write or semantic output.

Restore replays the complete S0/original-input prefix, reconstructing the initial
deadline schedule and M1-generated task slots. Compare complete saved state, queue,
allocator/ordinals, trace and private pending associations. Do not relax the inherited
ordered-input queue validator globally merely because the new model has private D.
Only the new closed save facade performs the composed pending-event reconciliation.
## Materialization gate still open

Bind the exact new bundle entries and registry entry specialization versions; build
canonical declarations using the frozen allocation; independently audit semantic
inventory, all slots, two-kind VAL coverage, event ceilings and old artifact hashes.
Freeze the resulting canonical profile commitments before runtime activation.
TC-A..L remain NOT PASSED. This is agent-owned construction work, not a user decision.
# Task lifecycle — internal symbolic shape review
## Reviewed boundary

The consolidated authority is docs/formal/TASK_COMMITMENTS.md together with its
normative registration closure. Seven new records, no new occurrence namespace,
one new physical prospective root, one sole owner and an explicit third route.
Task-plan state, workspace, appraisal, motives and options are excluded from this
acceptance. They cannot be implemented by filling those omissions locally.
## Exact symbolic member inventory for allocation review
These are additions within existing families, not new namespace proposals.

| Existing family | New exact text member |
|---|---|
| SemanticKindId/1004 | semantic-kind/task-commitment |
| DomainValidatorId/1021 | validator/task-qualification |
| SeamId/1036 | seam/task-commitment |
| TransitionKindId/1009 | TaskMeasurementSettlementTransition |
| TransitionKindId/1009 | TaskDeadlineSettlementTransition |
| EventTypeId/1001 | event/task-measurement-settlement |
| EventTypeId/1001 | event/task-measurement-settlement-padding |
| EventTypeId/1001 | event/task-deadline |
| LearningRouteId/1026 | route/prospective-control |
| Campaign2StateFamilyId/1031 | prospective-commitments |
| LeafFamilyId/1032 | leaf/task-commitment |
| MutationAuthorityId/1025 | authority/prospective-commitments |
| ProjectionAccessorId/1028 | accessor/task-commitment-prior |
| RegistryKindId/1023 | registry/task-commitment-spec |

Concrete task content1038 IDs and task-spec1027 IDs are finite model declarations,
not globally fixed members of this symbolic contract. Their exact first-model
payloads must be committed in later packaging; no task identifier namespace exists.
## Identity-role coverage

TaskMeasurementTargetRequirement SubjectAccessor/OutputAccessor use1028. Its
TaskSpecIds is a set, not a scalar identity-role position: the receiving compiler
checks every element's1027 namespace, kind, uniqueness and exact complete-domain
coverage. Do not attach a scalar265 role to the collection field. Embedded343,
274/275,276 and322 retain their existing identity-role declarations.

Both registrations' ExecutingSeamId uses1036. Deadline ConsumerEventTypeId uses1001
and OutputAccessor1028. All these roles have absent DomainValidator. ObservationRef
reuses existing237 identity roles; it is narrowed to the Observation variant by
this state-domain validator, not globally. No new identity qualification shortcut.
## Adversarial challenges and dispositions

* Available content does not adopt a task: S0 is a subset; absent stays absent.
* Two simultaneous obligations survive: windows may overlap; keys are distinct.
* Deadline priority is not guessed: half-open applicability proves disjoint targets.
* A new observation wrapper cannot fabricate source authority: live M1 association
  authenticates the immediate payload; restore replays the actual prefix.
* A forecast cannot retire a task: the target's read domain has no belief root.
* A task is not a character: separate qualifiers; REG sees only qualified characters.
* Early target reads are prohibited: resolve paths, collision check, then read B0.
* Old dispatcher exclusivity is not weakened implicitly: exact A+D/P+S+D/D grammar.
* Quiescent expiry is not REG pre-instant invalidity: the legitimate clock runs first.
* A third route cannot hide mutation: eleven-family coverage and exact sole paths.
* No output identity is invented to fill an empty lifecycle closure: state is the result.
* No task-plan field is reserved speculatively: later prospective planning needs an
  explicit new shape and storage decision.286 currently represents one root per family.

Source preflight iterates the actual stage events in scheduler order (EventSequence
within140), authenticating each source and its subject/targets; collision checking
follows complete successful resolution. Prior evaluation is forbidden until that
global preflight succeeds. This fixes deterministic first-failure order without
inventing cross-target value priority. Existing owning failures remain unchanged.
## Acceptance limits

This review establishes a complete bounded symbolic lifecycle proposal. It does
not execute CONTENT's second-kind validator, new roles, task state, schedule, dispatcher,
trace or persistence. It does not pass any TC vector, whole FCT, current future
topology or Campaign2. Unchanged earlier accepted artifact bytes are preservation
obligations of the upcoming allocation review, not assumed from this narrative.

Next: allocate only this exact inventory, independently audit numbers/fields/roles/
member coverage and preservation, then close its executable successor packaging.
Continue separate cognitive contracts without treating lifecycle acceptance as
evidence of generated goals-to-options or identity feedback.
# Task lifecycle — first symbolic closure pass

2026-09-09. Agent proposal addressing task-commitment/0.1-draft decisions1–4.
**Not whole-shape accepted. No permanent numeric allocations or implementation.**
## Proposed canonical payloads

Use the six-field TaskCommitmentSpec in the content/topology review. All fields are
required and ordered there. A TaskCommitmentKey has CharacterId then TaskReferent.
TaskCommitmentState has one map, Commitments, from that key to TaskCommitmentStatus.
TaskCommitmentStatus is a closed union:

| Variant | Required payload | Forbidden payload |
|---|---|---|
| Open | none | ObservationRef, ObservedAt |
| PerceivedSatisfied | ObservationRef, ObservedAt | none |
| DeadlineMissed | none | ObservationRef, ObservedAt |

ObservationRef is exactly the existing237 Observation variant, not an arbitrary
character-evidence union member. ObservedAt is the admitted203 historical instant
and must lie in the task window. DeadlineMissed's exact deadline is already in the
immutable governing spec; do not store a second deadline in status. Status has no
fresh occurrence identity. The task referent and normal scheduler/trace identifiers
are sufficient for this persistent result.

There is **no semantic lifecycle output** in the first profile. Both settlement
transitions have OutputDefinitions={}. Retirement is retained status, not a new
universal learning-evidence record. Later memory/identity consumers need an explicit
status-reading or evidence-production seam; trace cannot supply it implicitly.
## Exact content receiving grammar proposed

Each concrete170/1 record has the task kind and1038 StableId. All existing required
authoritative fields remain present. Its FormalSeamMappings is the one-element
canonical list containing the spec's RegistryDefinitionId. ReferencedRegistryIds
is exactly that same one-element list. ReferencedContentIds is exactly the spec's
HolderContentId. Lifecycle is the one-element list containing that spec reference.

DeclaredInputs, DeclaredOutputs, Preconditions, WorldEffects, UnitsDomainsBounds,
EpistemicVisibility, ObservationAffordances, ValidationInvariants, SourceProvenance
and ChangeHistory are empty canonical lists in this first specialization. Their
empty values do not mean the task lacks domain/lifecycle constraints: the fixed
receiving contract follows the declared spec. It rejects any other shape or extra
interpretation. The repeated reference positions serve CONTENT's declared-reference
and lifecycle/mapping obligations; the spec is the sole criterion/window authority.

This proposal must be challenged specifically against CONTENT_GOVERNANCE's requirement
to state inputs/visibility/domain. If an empty field would imply a contradictory
meaning rather than a delegated spec reference, refine the field grammar before
acceptance rather than rely on an implementation convention.

No content field contains pressure, concern, urgency, belief or a chosen action.
The initial-state rule, not an EpistemicVisibility shortcut, makes an Open task
adopted character context for its qualified holder. A third party cannot read it
because the content record exists.
## Deadline association and allocator composition
At initial run construction:

1. Validate the exact declared finite task-key set as Open, including holders,
   content/spec references and nonoverlapping windows per holder/prediction.
2. Compile original inputs through the new exact ordered-input profile.
3. In canonical TaskCommitmentKey order, allocate one ordinary shared EventId and
   EventSequence for each deadline after the original-input allocations.
4. Each deadline event has DueAt=Deadline, phase140, the declared deadline EventTypeId,
   payload=the exact task key, empty dependencies and no causal parent event.
5. Bind the complete resulting scheduled-event bytes privately to that task and
   its initial-state/model source. There is no fake parent or observation occurrence.

No runtime occurrence ordinal is consumed for deadline creation or execution. No
deadline event can be submitted as an original input or emitted by a domain handler.
Event allocation remains distinct from TaskReferent identity. Save/prefix replay
must reproduce the original-input-plus-deadline allocation order exactly.

Initial deadlines are positive because0≤ActiveFrom<Deadline. Future recurrence
windows may be dormant in S0, but their deadline associations already exist. No
dynamic adoption/recurrence is admitted by this finite profile.
## Measurement generation and target resolution

The successor M1 completion creates one additional prospective measurement-settlement
event at140 with its exact actual342 output. Existing memory formation, prediction
application and later diagnostic-read generation remain separately declared.
The permission-suppressed branch gets a corresponding empty private slot; it is not
an observation-bearing task input. Slot counts must be enumerated for the new model.

After exact generative/source admission, verify203 time equals the admitted M1
instant, use nested343/IDN, and select tasks for the qualified holder and matching
prediction criterion whose immutable window contains T. Selection ignores stored
status. Resolve all selected keys before any prior task-status evaluation.

The first profile's nonoverlapping windows allow at most one selected measurement
target. At its deadline it is excluded, so the simultaneous deadline and measurement
events cannot collide. If a recurrence starts then, measurement targets the new key.
Terminal prior status produces no change but remains an executed admitted dispatch.
## Stage and state validity

The new dispatcher must admit the explicitly enumerated combinations of existing
ADAPT batches, existing memory/prediction pairs, one prospective measurement slot
and the finite initial deadline slots. It cannot silently relax the old exclusive
dispatcher. Every group evaluates against the same B0, with source admission,
subject/key resolution and target-collision checks completed before prior evaluation.

Groups retain their own authorities and exact patches; the stage combines validated
disjoint patches, never a shared anonymous writer. No output/emitted event is legal
from the new lifecycle140 executors. Later trace/invariant failure rolls back all
groups and their private associations together.

Open at T≥Deadline is allowed structurally during an instant but is never active.
At quiescent commit, every such instance must be terminal, since its authenticated
deadline event must have executed. Do not incorrectly apply that quiescent invariant
at the new target instant before its legitimate deadline handler runs. This differs
from REG's frozen retained-D pre-instant validity requirement and must not change it.
## Trace and persistence

Measurement settlement records source342, actual IDN and selected prior-status
reads, exact patch/diff and no semantic output. Deadline settlement records no source
occurrence, the exact key input, its actual status read and patch/diff. Full model/run
identities remain the successor's, not old component-model identities.

Terminal observation provenance is stored in status and authenticated by original
S0/input prefix replay. Structural state validation checks variant/roles/window;
it cannot prove that arbitrary caller-supplied support genuinely occurred. Whole-save
equality and pending-association bijections supply that separate generative proof.
## Remaining shape work

The current draft still needs complete transition-registration/target-projection
records, role positions, exact error names, the exhaustive dispatcher matrix and
the finalized CONTENT field interpretation. The new prospective route requires its
own explicit shared-topology extension. No numbering, activation or TC-A..L pass is
authorized by this first closure pass.
